The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of hydrogen bonding and π-π interactions is not always sufficient to stabilize an organic crystal, especially when the latter is dominated by a proton-transfer reaction.
the absence of dominant aryl forces in TrOH·iBa is not due to any intrinsic deficiency in the troponoid framework.
the hydrogen-bonding network of TrOH·iBa, although extensive and highly directional, is devoid of the π-π, ion-π, and C-H...π interactions that typify other troponoid-based crystals.
